name: LV2
notes: 2026-10-29: Candidate originated in conversation; listed-in-prd is a legacy listed-only status, not PRD inclusion.
2026-10-29: A plugin standard is not an audio-processing executable; host and plugin support is a separate fact.
2026-10-29: Skill opportunity: further research first; a host-specific standalone workflow would need an actual plugin and tested host.
summary: Open standard defining an extensible C interface and bundles for audio plugins. It specifies how plugins and hosts interact; usable effects and instruments require a compatible host and individual plugins.
use_when: Evaluate interoperable audio plugin hosting and control
Identify host/plugin interfaces for a future audio workflow
avoid_when: Need a finished audio effect without a host: SoX
Need a project renderer without plugin-host integration: FFmpeg
license: ISC (specification implementation; individual plugins and hosts have separate licences)

assessment.rationale: The project documents an extensible audio-plugin standard and describes host/plugin bundles; release date and current host compatibility require verification.
